articles.summary: Mission Produce, Inc. (NASDAQ: AVO) (“Mission” or “the Company”) a world leader in sourcing, producing, and distributing fresh Hass avocados, today announced the expansion of its operations and distribution to Miami, Fla., enabling the Company to directly service customers in Florida with its signature World’s Finest Avocados™ and World’s Finest Mangos™, as well as provide ripening and bagging services. By operating in Miami, Mission is poised to enhance quality, availability and speed-to-shelf, creating added value for existing customers while expanding its reach in the region.
articles.title: Mission Produce® Expands Distribution to Miami to Serve High-growth Southeast Market
